name: Hollow Oath-Eater
loreTies: A Gateborn hunger that feeds on promises made under pressure, especially Asgardian vows and Empyrean edicts.
Punishes Deities that repeat the same objective action without support.
Erasure is not death; erasure is ownership without memory.
shortBackstory: Hollow Oath-Eater is a Hollow threat creature built for campaign and event encounters, turning erased memory into major battlefield pressure.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Hollow Oath-Eater formed where the Hollow learned a specific weakness in remembered civilization. It is not a Deity, not a citizen, and not a recruitable unit; it is a symptom of the Gate giving absence a body.

chapters.title: Hollow Function
chapters.text: Its role inside the Hollow threat faction is precise: Punishes Deities that repeat the same objective action without support. This lets mission designers select it by encounter tags instead of treating Hollow enemies as one shapeless swarm.

chapters.title: Lore Tie
chapters.text: A Gateborn hunger that feeds on promises made under pressure, especially Asgardian vows and Empyrean edicts.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: Hollow Oath-Eater can appear in Normal missions, Elite remixes, Hollow Breach events, Ascension floors, and raid add waves when its tags match the objective pressure. It must always reinforce Hollowing: isolation, corrupted memory, broken objectives, or stolen meaning.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Art and gameplay must keep Hollow Oath-Eater visibly non-playable. Its silhouette uses heavy black beast-knight with ringed jaw, torn rune chains, oath-stone lodged in chest, white crack-teeth. while its abilities — Vow Bite, Break Resolve, Oath Drain — create battlefield pressure without confusing it for a faction Deity.

developmentStatus: Readable Hollow creature profile integrated into campaign/event threat pages.
